review_notes: Reviewed all 21 target lines and the imported definitions of substitute, eval, collectBalanced, and their evaluation lemmas. Also checked that the existing evaluation lemmas use different simp attributes. The proposed change is to eval_substitute at its defining site, rather than to add a potentially duplicative local rule.

findings.problem: This evaluation proof must explicitly name eval_substitute because that theorem is not a simp rule, even though eval_collectBalanced is already tagged [simp]. Thus the standard simplifier does not normalize eval (substitute v rows) to eval v (fun k => eval (rows k) x). The rewrite removes the outer substitute and does not recreate it, so it provides a terminating evaluation normal form.
findings.proposed_change: Add [simp] to Integer.Sparse.eval_substitute at its definition in MixedTargetBasic.lean. Then this proof can use simp [originalBlockCheck78] (or omit the explicit evaluation rewrites).
findings.benefit: Makes evaluation of substituted sparse expressions normalize consistently with evaluation after collectBalanced, and removes a repeated manual rewrite from this target and the sibling block proofs that use the same pattern.
